source: The host directory containing this .claude checkout and sibling .workspaces directory.
rules: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are host bootstrap files installed from .claude/init. Project setup does not create these files or another .claude in routed backend/frontend sources.
Read the selected project's binding before resolving Work or target code. Preserve Source when entering another repository or worktree.
Resolve source-relative repository paths from Source, not from .claude or the current target checkout. Verify each actual Git remote against the declared repository before effects.
The project's backend repository owns .starciwork. FE and other sources share that Work via the registry; do not create duplicate Work in the central registry or frontend.

The same backend owns internal .starciwork/_local/plans for both BE and FE workflow state. The host registry is not project state; a host may also be a backend only when the selected binding explicitly names it as that role.

Tasks launched outside the host must receive its absolute project skill path and selected binding explicitly. Directory changes and AGENTS.md discovery in a frontend do not discover instructions in a separate host automatically.
Each backend project retains its own durable Work tree. .workspaces stores routing references, never business progress, evidence or workflow history.
If a binding or target is missing, inspect existing project route files and propose the exact mapping; never silently use an illustrative outputs workspace as project Work.
Use the resolved backend Work root for schema validation, workflow goals, external local workflow records, evidence and completion.

Before new workspace or Plan creation, inspect backend storage with starci storage. Canonical names are .starciwork and internal .starciwork/_local; legacy .work/.starci means migration-required, mixed names mean conflict. Coordinate migration before new planning, never create a parallel tree. Existing bound Plan bundles may resume in place until a safe migration checkpoint; never relocate active records or rewrite approvals silently. State I/O is resolved by workflows/storage.mjs.
